name: Russian SFSR (1937–1954)
description: A red field with the initials 'РСФСР' in yellow Cyrillic letters in the upper hoist.
history: Flag laid down by the 1937 constitution of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic, simplifying the ornate 1918 monogram into plain gold lettering without a border. It was replaced on 9 January 1954 by the red flag with a blue hoist stripe and the hammer and sickle, used until 1991.
